date_last_updated.why: Clearing 2026-01-15 is correct: that is the date SI 2026/31 was made, a commencement step, not an amendment or new version of section 138. 'No known outstanding effects' on the section page.

summary_claims.claim: Inserts ss.66E-66H into the Sexual Offences Act 2003; offence to create or request creation of a purported intimate image, covering images that appear to be a photograph or film but are not
Section 138 in force 6 February 2026 by SI 2026/31 reg. 2; not in force at Royal Assent (s.142(1))

scope.note: Not an AI-specific law; section 138 is the operative UK offence on creating sexually explicit deepfakes. The extractor's scope_note is appropriate.

note: legislation.gov.uk section page, SI 2026/31, the Act's introduction page and the King's Printer PDF confirm Royal Assent 19 June 2025, c. 18 s.138 and commencement on 6 February 2026. New note details (summary-only offences, 3-year time limit, review within two years) match the s.66E-66H text. No amendment or repeal found; the page shows no outstanding effects.
